{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out sentinel values for baseline
valid_data = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Stratify by severity and compute response rate and biomarker change within each stratum
stratified_results = valid_data.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).agg(
    response_rate=('responded', 'mean'),
    biomarker_change=('biomarker_final', 'sub'),  # Will be computed as final - baseline
    n=('patient_id', 'count')
).reset_index()

# Compute baseline biomarker as final - baseline
stratified_results['biomarker_change'] = stratified_results['biomarker_final'] - stratified_results['biomarker_baseline']

# Now compute the difference in response rate and biomarker change within each severity level
# We will compute treatment - control within each severity stratum

# Pivot to make arm the columns
stratified_pivot = stratified_results.pivot_table(
    index='severity',
    columns='arm',
    values=['response_rate', 'biomarker_change'],
    aggfunc='mean'
)

# Compute differences within each stratum
stratified_pivot['response_diff'] = stratified_pivot['response_rate']['treatment'] - stratified_pivot['response_rate']['control']
stratified_pivot['change_diff'] = stratified_pivot['biomarker_change']['treatment'] - stratified_pivot['biomarker_change']['control']

# Display results
print(stratified_pivot[['response_diff', 'change_diff']])"}
